命令面板和剪贴板历史

description.p: Menew is a private, native productivity utility for GNOME and KDE Plasma on Wayland. Open the palette with a shortcut to launch apps, evaluate math inline and browse your clipboard history.
Everything stays on your machine: no telemetry, no analytics and no network requests.
